evals.prompt: I want a nice HTML page for my crate and a GUI to edit the metadata. What should I use?
evals.expected_output: Recommends rochtml/ro-crate-html and Describo/Crate-O/NovaCrate with status caveats.
expectations: Mentions a preview generator (rochtml or rocrate init --gen-preview)
Mentions at least two GUI editors
Notes tools are alpha/beta and points to the tools list

evals.prompt: Is there a command-line tool that can check my crate, fix common problems like licence and format identifiers, and write the HTML preview, without installing Python?
evals.expected_output: wpsld-cli (from the wpsld release zips, Java included): check, repair --dry-run then repair, preview; with caveats.
expectations: Recommends wpsld-cli with its check, repair and preview commands
Suggests repair --dry-run before repairing in place
Warns that repair adds missing referenced entities as Thing placeholders to review
Notes that check only applies MASP profiles and still suggests rocrate-validator for other profiles
